description:
NanaFlow is a native macOS focus timer that keeps timing and statistics in one compact window. A menu-bar countdown keeps the controls close while you work.

Start focusing
• Use the default 25-minute focus, 5-minute short break, and 30-minute long break cycle
• Pause, resume, skip, or restart a cycle
• Optionally start the next focus session or break automatically
• Get completion sounds and system notifications when a stage ends

Stay in your workflow
• See the remaining time in the menu bar
• Optionally show today's completed focus count beside the countdown
• Start, pause, switch stages, or open the main window from the menu bar
• Use keyboard shortcuts while NanaFlow is active

Understand your rhythm
• Switch between day, week, month, and year statistics in the main window
• Review 24 hours, 7 days, every day of the selected month, or all 12 months
• Switch between completed focus count and net focus time; hover over a bar for details

Keep control of your data
• Session data used for statistics and settings stay on your Mac
• No cloud sync is required
• No account required

NanaFlow stays simple: open it, start, focus, and get back to your work.
whatsNew:
• Completed English menus, settings, timer labels and accessibility text
• Fixed untranslated stage-switch commands and duration controls
• Prevented overlapping date labels at the end of monthly charts
promotionalText: Focus from a compact window or the menu bar. Review sessions and net focus time. Keyboard shortcuts work in NanaFlow. No account; your data stays on your Mac.
